queries: WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS rating_average FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(rating_average) AS overall_mean FROM rating_averages) SELECT r.rating, r.rating_average, r.rating_average - o.overall_mean AS amount_above_overall_mean FROM rating_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_mean IS NOT NULL AND r.rating_average > o.overall_mean ORDER BY r.rating

WITH rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS average_rate_per_day FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY rating), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(average_rate_per_day) AS mean_rate_per_day FROM rating_averages) SELECT r.rating, r.average_rate_per_day, r.average_rate_per_day - o.mean_rate_per_day AS amount_above_mean FROM rating_averages AS r CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS o WHERE r.average_rate_per_day > o.mean_rate_per_day
